texts.preamble: Nand Lal vs State (2024:Rj-Jd:49706) on 4 December, 2024 Author: Manoj Kumar Garg Bench: Manoj Kumar Garg [2024:Rj-Jd:49706] High Court Of Judicature For Rajasthan At Jodhpur S.B. Criminal Revision Petition No. 869/2005 Nand Lal S/o Tulsi Ram, B/c Kumawat, R/o Achnera, Ps Arnod, District Chittorgarh (At present lodged in District Jail, Pratapgarh, in the process of transfer to Central Jail, Udaipur.) ----Petitioner Versus State of Rajasthan ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Rajiv Bishnoi For Respondent(s) : Mr. Narendra Gehlot, Pp with Mr. Op Choudhary Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Manoj Kumar Garg Judgment 04/12/2024 1. By way of filing the instant Criminal Revision Petition under Section 397/401 of Cr.P.C., challenge has been made to the judgment dated 27.09.2005 passed by the learned Additional Sessions Judge and Special Judge, Sc/St (Prevention of Atrocities Cases), Pratapgarh in Criminal appeal No.16/2004, whereby the learned appellate court dismissed and appeal and affirmed the judgment dated 21.05.2003 passed by the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Pratapgarh in Criminal Regular Case No.36/1993 whereby the learned trial court convicted the petitioner for the offence under Section 7/16 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and sentenced him to undergo one year's simple imprisonment alongwith a fine of Rs.2000/- and in default of payment of fine, to further undergo three months S.I. [2024:Rj-Jd:49706] (2 of 5) [Crlr-869/2005]
texts.facts: 2. Bereft of elaborate details, facts relevant and essential for disposal of the instant criminal revision are that on 07.05.1992 Food Inspector Murarilal Sharma took samples of soybean oil from the shop of the petitioner. After following due procedure, the samples were sent for examination and the same were found to be adulterated. The Learned Magistrate framed the charge against the petitioner for the offence under Section 7/16 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and upon denial of guilt by him, commenced the trial. During the course of trial, the prosecution in order to prove the offence, examined the witnesses and exhibited various documents. The accused, upon being confronted with the prosecution allegations, in his statement under Section 313 CrPC, denied the allegations and claimed to be innocent. Hence, this revision petition is filed before this court.
texts.arguments: 4. After arguing the case on merits to some extent, learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that he will not assail conviction of the petitioner and confines his arguments to the alternative prayer of reduction of the sentence awarded by the trial court. He submits that the incident in the present case pertains to the year 1992. He was not having any criminal [2024:RJ-JD:49706] (3 of 5) [CRLR-869/2005] antecedents and it was the first criminal case registered against him. No adverse remark has been passed over his conduct except the impugned judgment. The petitioner has already suffered agony of protracted trial of 32 years. The petitioner has remained in custody for a period of three days out of total sentence of one year's S.I. With these submissions, learned counsel prays that by taking a lenient view, the sentence awarded to the petitioner may be reduced to the period already undergone. The petitioner also deserves the benefit of the consistent view taken by this court in this Nand Lal vs State (2024:Rj-Jd:49706) on 4 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/59287211/ 2 regard. Thus, guided by the judicial pronouncements made by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the cases of Haripada Das Vs. State of West Bangal, reported in (1998 9 SCC 678 and Alister Anthony Pareira vs. State of Maharashtra reported in 2012 2 SCC 648 and considering the facts and circumstances of the case, age of petitioner, his criminal antecedents, his status in the society and the fact that he faced financial hardship and had to go through mental agony, this court is of the view that ends of justice would be met, if sentence imposed upon the petitioner is reduced to the period already undergone by him.
